!3 CSV: ordered, unordered and key
By default row N is compared with row N. '''unordered''' pairs each expected row with the first free actual row it matches; '''key''' pairs rows by one or more columns (names separated by commas) and implies unordered. A key cell cannot be a wildcard. '''ordered''' clears the order settings but keeps the separator.

|separator|;|

1;a
2;b}}}|{{{id;v
2;b
1;a}}}|OK|

2;b}}}|{{{id;v

1;a}}}|OK|
